$comment: SOURCE, NOT GENERATED. Hand-written notes for the changelog, keyed by version, plus `unreleased` for work that has no version yet. Everything else on that page is derived from git, which is the right way round for drawings: a list of what was added or redrawn should never be typed. A release is not always drawings, though. The corner treatment added a whole axis without adding a name, so git had nothing to report and the page announced 48 redraws and nothing else. Write a note only where the release did something a count cannot describe, lead with what changed and how much, and keep it to two sentences: this sits above the tiles, not instead of them. Numbers go in as {names} and {files} and are counted at build, because a typed number is a claim with an expiry date and this repository has already shipped three of them. Plain prose, since neither the page nor the Paper board renders markdown. Entries are never edited once published, for the reason pipeline/README.md gives about the changelog only ever growing.
1.3.0: rocket-2 is rocket-fast now, named for the speed lines it shares with the new drawings. The old name still finds it in search and still imports in React.
1.1.0: The starred drawings gather on an AI shelf with the bots and the brains, the marks that sat under Actions take Math and Keyboard shelves of their own, and every star on the AI shelf is one bigger pair, so a sparkle reads as a sparkle at 16 pixels. The whole set also installs in React Native now, with the same names, styles and corners as the React package.
1.0.0: Four styles now, with every name in all of them: {files} SVGs across {names} names. The outlined duotone is called two-tone from this release, so an import of duotone that wants the old look changes to two-tone, and duotone is a new style with no outline, a grey body with the part that matters in black, drawn icon by icon. A hundred and forty-nine drawings and a People shelf to hold six of them: the boy, the girl, a baby with a curl, one with a bow, and both again with a pacifier. The panels gain their close, open and dashed forms on every side and three split layouts, the phone takes call, incoming, outgoing, missed and forwarded, the big arrows point four ways, long and short, the heading comes with its six levels, the tablet takes its upright form and the phone's eight signs, the laptop sits beside a phone, two banknotes carry a check, minus, plus and x, and the alarm clock takes a check, plus and minus beside a stopwatch and its reset, a snowflake, wind, a table and a zipped folder, a rocket climbs on its flame, trails speed lines and stands upright, a hand closes and opens beside the pointer, a watch, a hard drive, a cable and a headset visor join the devices, AirPlay, a film camera and a broadcast mast join the media with a phone that casts and a search over sound, both message bubbles take a sparkle and send takes a clock, a voice, contacts, an ID card and the accessibility figure join the users, and a shield takes a key beside a siren, delete, a gauge, two toggles, a heart on a map pin, a shopping basket, a file search, a turn with a plus, humidity and three kinds of cloud, an app window with its signs, sticky notes, a folder tree and a typed file, the case marks, a CCTV camera, a mouse, a shredder, a radio, a fingerprint, an incognito hat, a shirt, a paper bag, a milestone, a swatch book, the earth, the recycling arrows, a car, a wallet with its cards, a bot with a slash and a pen with sparkles. The pointer is drawn again in all four directions, the paperclip runs longer, the dice take larger pips, the three dots are larger, play is smaller, the gallery frames take a tighter radius, the grid and file fills keep 2 units clear of their edges, the charts grey their axes in two-tone, the four dashed close panels sit their grey under the frame's round corners, and the coins sit on rounder faces with 2 units between every coin.
0.9.0: Fifty-three drawings and six shelves: Transport, Nature, Animals, AI, Science and Health. heart-hand is hand-heart now, and the old name still finds it. The sharp duotone truck's plate no longer shows past its rear wheel.
0.8.0: Thirty-three drawings off a month of empty searches, and five shelves: Home, Gender, Food & Drink, Art and Stationery. The calendar and the phone are redrawn.
0.3.0: Sharp corners, across the whole set: {files} SVGs now, against {names} names, because every drawing has a squared-off twin. It is a switch in the browser rather than a second library, and it ships through the same doors the styles do.
0.4.0: Every sharp diagonal end is cut back to its round cap's box, on 329 icons: the chevrons, arrowheads, signs and slashes that painted 0.414 outside their rounded siblings sit on the same box now, and every arc the converter had bent by moving its endpoint is a true arc again. settings-dot's sharp gear is cut on its cap's own line, so its grey plate ends flush with the black instead of escaping past it, and circle-navigation sits centred in its box.
0.5.0: Two names changed hands: the diagonal chain is link now and the horizontal one link-2, which is the naming the rest of the set already follows, and link-off became link-2-off with it, so an import of either wants updating. Four sharp drawings that painted outside their rounded siblings were re-solved rather than exempted, and the formatting marks moved onto a Text shelf of their own.
0.6.0: The seven currency marks arrive with circled halves, and those hold 1 unit of daylight against the ring rather than the 2 the guide asks between elements: a container is the frame a drawing sits in, not a neighbour it has to be told apart from, and at 2 a letterform comes out at about half the well. Bitcoin has no circled half, because its four stubs stand outside the letter at both ends and solving them shrinks the B until its bowls carry 1 unit of white instead of 2.
0.7.0: A QR code, scissors in both bodies, an hourglass, a scan frame with six things to read inside it, twenty-six charts, four diagrams, seven faces and a badge with nine signs. And the message family drawn again on a square body, with every sign, badge and slash where the round bubble already puts them.
